# Code of Conduct

Participants are expected to be respectful, constructive, and professional.
Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, and disruptive behavior are not
welcome.

Conduct concerns may be reported in a GitHub issue when it is safe to do so.
Do not post personal, confidential, security-sensitive, or otherwise sensitive
information in a public report. Maintainers may moderate or remove content and
take other action needed to keep the project safe and productive.
